This chat is designed for discussing all feedback, suggestions, and questions related to game development. Here, you can leave your thoughts, report bugs, or propose ideas to improve the game. We value every piece of feedback and aim to make the game as high-quality as possible. Your suggestions will help us fix issues and enhance the gameplay experience.
